component.name: MyApps
component.summary: View and manage installed Linux applications

description.p: MyApps is a user-friendly tool for Linux that displays all installed applications clearly - without system clutter.
MyApps ist ein benutzerfreundliches Tool für Linux, das alle installierten Anwendungen übersichtlich darstellt - ohne System-Clutter.

ul.li: Multi-distribution support (Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Arch, Fedora, etc.)
Modern GTK4 + Libadwaita GUI with native dark mode
Virtual scrolling — all apps in one list, no pagination
Desktop Apps view — shows only apps with .desktop entries
Intelligent filtering of system apps
Search function (name + description)
Sort by name, size or install date
Export functions (TXT, CSV, JSON)
Multilingual (German, English)

screenshot.caption: Table view with all package information
Tabellenansicht mit allen Paket-Informationen

description.p: Performance release: Virtual Scrolling and Update Notifications

ul.li: Virtual Scrolling — no more pagination, all apps in one list
GTK4 renders only visible items, fast even with 2000+ packages
Update notification banner when new MyApps version is available
Sort bar replaces pagination bar
New "Desktop" tab showing only apps with .desktop entries
Detects apps from system, user, Flatpak and Snap paths
Localized app names and descriptions
48px icons in Desktop view

description.p: Scope, size, date and sorting features

ul.li: Scope dropdown: User Apps / All Packages
Installed size column (dpkg, rpm, pacman, flatpak, snap)
Install date column with localized display
Sort by name, size or install date (7 options)
Minimum 5 characters for search
Icon caching — icons loaded only once
Sorting optimized — only once after filtering
Memory leak fixed in list view
Export format bug fixed (CSV/JSON now work correctly)
Modern GTK4 + Libadwaita interface with native dark mode
Search function (name + description)
Improved export dialog
